retrievalProfile.description: A close-up studio portrait featuring a subject in a black leather jacket with large, horizontally-stretched display typography layered over the lower third.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, slightly tilted studio portrait of a person wearing a textured black leather jacket, characterized by warm, soft lighting and a neutral background, with bold, wide-set typography anchored at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hand placement creates a frame for the face
High-gloss leather texture contrasts with soft skin tones
Heavy, wide typography balances the visual weight of the dark jacket
Neutral background ensures the subject remains the primary focus
coreInvariants: Warm studio lighting with soft shadows
Black leather jacket with visible zippers and texture
Lower-third placement for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, coral-colored text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the hand on the head, then down the leather jacket to the bold text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily in the upper corners against a light, neutral backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (jacket and hair) providing depth and structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/Light grey background for subject separation.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Coral/Salmon pink for primary typography to pop against the dark jacket.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between background and jacket; moderate saturation in skin tones and accent text.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to warm neutrals and one muted accent color

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a large, circular counter
Ascenders and descenders are minimized to emphasize width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide display text paired with ultra-condensed subtitle text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule/line separating subtitle from display text

preserve: Horizontal stretch of the main name
Coral/pink color for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 90s tech-influenced wide sans-serif look.
Provides the necessary geometric stability and horizontal presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person with dark hair wearing a black leather biker jacket, hand resting on head, warm lighting, off-white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, horizontally stretched name in coral pink at the bottom, with a smaller condensed subtitle in white just above it, separated by a thin white line.

verificationChecks: Is the main text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the leather jacket texture clearly visible?
Is the lighting warm and flattering on the skin?
Does the text overlap the bottom of the subject's torso?

adjustableVariables: Degree of horizontal stretch on typography
postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is centered horizontally.
Ensure the coral color is distinct from the skin tones.
Check that the leather jacket has highlights and shadows.
Confirm the subtitle is legible despite its small size.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Leather Jacket + Extended Sans-Serif Overlay = 90s R&B Aesthetic
